contract: Operations, financial, environmental, and combined deterministic summaries must use their fixed registered source-table inventory and carry exactly one source-reference entry per declared table.
failure_behavior: The signed worker rejects missing or extra source tables/references before returning a read-only result or invoking the draft writer; the source transaction is rolled back and closed.
limitations: Source references identify bounded source rows; they are not content snapshots or a proof that populated legacy outputs are semantically equivalent.
This source contract does not establish live provider, runtime recovery, or MAN-CAP-038 owner acceptance.
